# Playtest diary: r15d-typed-full

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a retired air-traffic controller who logs every clock reading, plans each move and types complete sentences
- **Model:** claude-opus-5-5
- **Seed:** 81450
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 1a04b2f2
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 15d
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-10-11/r15d-typed-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

### Leg 1 (model: claude-opus-5-5)

**Cmds 1-12.** Clock 5381 at start; each command seems to cost 7-30 time units (moves ~22, actions ~7). Read all three forms from the package papers (Activation HB-56-V, Robot Use JZ-59-G, Assignment Completion QX-17-T; the last 'has not been validated'). Storage room aft: boxes of forms, Ensign Blather slouched past. Starboard: Cargo Bay Entrance; fore of it the Robot Pool. Put the Robot Use form in the slot, typed 3, and Floyd (my old companion from Resida) bounded over. Plan: go into the cargo bay, find the spacetruck, use the activation form.

**Cmds 13-36.** Cargo Bay: spacetruck. Took survival kit (orange goo, gray goo, Thermos). Activation form refused until both seats filled; I sat in pilot seat and Floyd followed into copilot. Inserted form at time 5674; typed course 193 (table row 5650-5699). Launch, waited 5 times (time jumps ~240 per wait). Docked at bay two, "Stationfall", +5. Hunger/thirst warning at 6921: drank the blue soup from the Thermos; game says neither hungry nor thirsty, can eat again in ~320 moves.

**Cmds 37-62.** Station map: Docking Bay #2 -E- Level Five (lobby; elevator E, ladder up/down, doors N, W, corridor NE/SE). N: Workshop (twenty-ohm bedistor, taken), N of it: Storage (dark). NE: North Junction (corridor N, door E, doorway NE). E: Sick Bay (security door E with ID reader, my ID did nothing). Met robot Plato, who says he hasn't seen a soul for a day. SE: East Connection (iris hatch to Military Sub-Module, slot). S: Comm Center (red emergency beacon button, blank screen). SW: Station Control (monitors). S: Commander's Office (log reader fixed, no tape). E: Commander's Quarters (safe, log tape, validation stamp under bed). Log reader exploded after I listened. Floyd and Plato play hide and seek and follow me.

**Cmds 87-141.** Briefing Room (S of office) -W- South Connection (Diplomatic iris hatch + slot). Welder Number 1 came at me there; I fled east and it moved off. Saved in Briefing Room (7716). W of South Connection: Robot Shop, unconscious robot Oliver, heating chamber; Floyd fetched the medium drill bit (+3). South Junction: SW dark File Room, SE Commander's Office, NW Level Five. Up ladder: Level Four (barracks N/S, Docking Bay #3 W with lilac nanofilm spool 'Spacetruck Refueling Instructions'). Tiredness warning at 8114: slept in Female Barracks bed (+3), woke Novem 5 at 1606 with a dream about Floyd refusing to open pod bay doors. Auto-doors now sluggish. Level Three: Gym (machine, sign about frequency 710), Theatre (locked projection booth), Laundry (dryer empty, presser, washer missing). Hunger again at 2014: ate orange goo. Floyd and Plato went to the library.

**Cmds 142-199.** Presser in Laundry (steams when on). Chapel (SW of Level Three): blinking seven-pointed star out of reach, eternal flame, pulpit hides switch that turns the flame off/on; puce spool. Level Two = Mess Hall (dispensers spray acid! cup of cold coffee taken), Main Storage N (detonator with blackened hyperdiode - removed it), Meeting Room 1 NE (Welder 3, fled), Library SE (spool reader, terminal removed), Meeting Room 2 N of Library (Welder 1, fled). Spools played: both garbled, end "You will die, human!". Top: Dome (locked warm storage bin 'Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies', air shaft grating fixed). PA: deep-space message at Comm Center. Climbing pulpit fails (sways). Saved in Mess Hall at 2388. Spools and blackened diode left in Library.

**Cmds 200-251.** Throwing the coffee at the star just vaporised the cup. Floyd and Plato both too short for the star. Comm Center message: abort and return to Duffy. Iris hatch slot spits out my ID. North Junction NE: The PX (Vendo-Matic, 1 galakmid; timer and large drill bit available). North Connection -> Tube -> Sci Sub-Module: Engineering Lab/Office (Schmidt's diary), Astro Lab (fromitz board, taken)/Office, Scientists' Quarters, Bio Lab/Office (note), Holding Tank (blasted, empty). Welders 1 and 4 hunted me there; moving away always works. North Connection W = dark Storage. Level Six (ladder down from Five): Docking Bay #1 NW with the alien ship, skeleton, dots, empty pedestal.

**Cmds 252-320.** Licked the dots (tastes recorded). Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks N (+SanFac), Officers' Quarters A (S), SanFac, C, B, End of Corridor (security door N with ID reader, dark Shipping Room E), Docking Bay #4 SW (empty). Level Seven: Printing Plant (trash can with crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q; mauve spool 'Collater Repair Manual'), Paper Recycling Plant NW (drill with small bit, motor tired). Ladder to Level Eight sealed from below. Hunger at 4285: ate gray goo, no food left. Pressed the crumpled form in the Laundry presser (close, turn on, wait, off), stamped it with the validation stamp, put it in the South Connection slot: hatch half-opened (+6, score 17). Saved there. Weightless in the village. Main Street (up, NE, S, W, SE ramp). Travel Agency W (posters). Bank SE of it: took a platinum detector, now on.

**Cmds 321-362.** Greasy Straw NE of Main St (cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar behind counter). Trading Post NE of that (sign: FREZONE explosive; instruction sheet; twelve-prong fromitz board). Down: Warehouse (vacuum storage door down, 'Trespassers will be spaced!'), SW: Alley. Main St up: Mayor's Office, textbook with taste glossary -> decoded the dots: weakness = element 78 (platinum). Alley S: Loan Shark (strong box, huge lock; drill has ONE hole left - kept it). Alley E: Junk Yard (magnetic spaceboots; warning they would wipe my ID card - left them). Up: Shady Dan's, ID machine: put card in small slot, typed 9 -> 'New rank is 9: HyperAdmiral.' Welder 1 nearly got me; fled NW to Trading Post. Saved there (5382).

**Cmds 363-400.** Trading Post E: Saloon; E: Casino (dice, roulette wheel). Spinning the wheel opened exits N and up (+4, score 21). N: Opium Den (anti-drug sign). Up: Flophouse, locker with space suit - dropped kit, took and wore the suit, took kit back. Took dice. Saloon NW: Grocery (plastic bag of vacuum taffy). N: Broadway; W: Makeshift Connector, west of it a half-dilated iris hatch my suit is too bulky for (probably the station's East Connection). Broadway down: Fortune Teller with crystal ball ('Tips: ...wave your hands around the crystal ball'; waving did nothing). Platinum detector: 'getting warm' on entering Casino from the Opium Den, 'getting very warm' at Fortune Teller. Saved at Fortune Teller (5920). Leg ended at 400.

### Leg 2 (model: claude-opus-5-5)

**Start.** Resumed at Fortune Teller, clock 5952 Novem 5, score 21. Plan: search for the platinum here, then security doors with the HyperAdmiral card.

**Cmds 401-470.** Took crystal ball (nothing special). Broadway: N Recruitment Office (posters), NE Rec Shop (simulation booth: a Zork-like treasure sim), E Field Office (headlamp - taken, worn, on), SE Barbershop (mirror; W to Grocery), SW Pet Store (Arcturian balloon creature in cage, leash; sign). Detector went 'too hot to handle' in Field Office and dropped; Floyd picked it up. Went to Warehouse airlock in suit, closed kit, closed upper door, opened lower: blown into space, died (6520). Restored Fortune Teller 5920; redid headlamp. Opened the balloon cage; can't grab leash in suit gloves; without suit, grabbing it makes the creature fart and I drop everything. Welders 1, 3, 4 keep coming at the Pet Store; I flee NE/SE each time. Detector 'too hot' again in Pet Store, left there.

**Cmds 471-530.** Hunger+thirst warning at 6552: walked back to Pet Store for the taffy, had to take off the suit to eat (6709). Plan for vacuum: dropped ID card in Alley, wore magnetic boots from the Junk Yard, suit on, closed kit, cycled airlock: boots held me In Space ('vac yard'); headlamp revealed the FREZONE cylinder (+3, score 24). Put explosive in the Thermos and closed it. Back up, dropped boots in Warehouse, retrieved ID card (Welder 4 menaced; fled). Headlamp dims - turned it off. Balloon creature: game hint says it will always flee in zero-gee, 'Perhaps it would behave differently somewhere with gravity.' Space suit too heavy with the kit+drill; left in Pet Store with plastic bag. Detector picked up again (now cool), on.

**Cmds 531-575.** Drank nectar at Fortune Teller (not thirsty; next hunger ~235 moves). Saloon W = Trading Post; Main St S = Bank (doors N, NW). Grimy Passage: tiredness warning at 7511. Crossing into the station at South Connection: '(Even sealed in the Thermos bottle, the explosive is getting softer.)' Saved there (7533). Went back to re-store the explosive in vacuum; at the Trading Post Plato ambushed me with a stun ray, told the Zeenak/Hunji pyramid story (the pyramid turns machines against their makers and builds replicas); I said 'Floyd, attack Plato' and Floyd knocked the gun away; Plato was blown apart (+7, score 31). I'd dropped everything when stunned. 'Really tired' at 7833. At 7906: 'The game can no longer be won: the explosive has melted away, and there was only the one.' Restored Fortune Teller 5920 (score 21). LESSON: fetch the FREZONE last, right before the safe.

**Cmds 576-639 (replay from 5920).** Dropped dice+stamp at Fortune Teller, got headlamp, left the space suit in the Field Office, squeezed W from Broadway through Makeshift Connector into East Connection (the half-open hatch needs no suit). HyperAdmiral card opens Sick Bay E (Brig, three empty cells) and End of Corridor N (Armory, +5, score 26: fusor-beam zapgun, indicator '7'). Storage W of North Connection (dark, lit by headlamp): jammer with twenty sockets; put the twenty-prong board in, set it to 710. In the Gym exercise machine with the jammer on: 'The machine seems to be frozen'; off: normal reps. Purpose still unclear. Hunger 6537: ate taffy. Saved in the exercise machine (6573). Elevator is weightless; 8 refuses, 6 works. Left: nectar in Storage, bag + platinum detector in Armory.

**Cmds 640-689.** Shipping Room (dark, E of End of Corridor): pallets of 'Request for Stellar Patrol Issue Regulation Black Form Binders Request Form Forms'; sign about returning the forklift (forklift missing). File Room: empty. Station Control monitors at 7006: COMMUNICATION RED, LIFE SUPPORT RED, FOOD RED, GRAVITY YELLOW, COMPUTER GREEN, POWER RED, PRINTING RED - getting worse. PX hole empty. Dome: zapgun on the bin lock just made the bin glow (Footnote 9 joke); restored Dome save (7262) to get the charge back. Theatre booth locked. Tired at 7516 in Female Barracks: slept; woke Novem 6 - my CHRONOMETER HAS STOPPED (no more clock in the status line). Dropped everything in bed; picked it all up.

**Cmds 690-773.** After sleeping in the Barracks, Plato's ambush came at once; Floyd killed him (+7) but then 'The game can no longer be won: the headlamp is dead, with the explosive left in the dark' - I had left it on. Restored Dome 7262, lamp off. Walked to the village; tired at 7521 near the Loan Shark; slept in Flophouse (Ramos dream; chronometer stops). Plato ambush right after waking: 4x 'Floyd, attack Plato' -> +7 (33). Saved Flophouse. ZAPGUN on the Loan Shark strong box: 'vaporized, leaving a solitary coin!' ONE GALAKMID (+5, 38). Saved at PX. Coin + type 6: 'klunk' but nothing appears; kicking/shaking fails; I can feel it with fingertips but can't grip; Floyd: 'Nope, not even a ball.' Zapping the dispenser destroyed it -> restored PX. Hunger at the coin: drank the nectar - '(That was the last food you will find.)'

**Cmds 774-800.** Back at the PX with Floyd: coin, type 6, klunk again; Floyd: 'not even a ball'. 'put the drill in the hole': 'You shove the drill up into the hole. A moment later, it drops out' - so the timer is stuck up inside. Dropped the ID card in the PX, walked to the Junk Yard, took and wore the magnetic boots (to try magnetism on the timer), walking back; leg ended at Level Five.

### Leg 3 (model: claude-opus-5-5)

**Start.** Resumed at Level Five wearing the magnetic boots, Novem 6 (chronometer stopped), score 38. Plan: PX, try the boots on the stuck timer.

**Cmds 801-856.** PX: boots in the hole drop out (not magnetic enough); hit/push/kick 'fails to dislodge the timer'; Floyd 'not even a ball'; typing 6 again: 'You have not deposited a coin.' Drilling the dispenser: implosion, death (Demolitions Manual joke) - restored a PX save made just before (move 587). Left boots + ID on PX floor. Went to Pet Store via East Connection; dropped all; opened cage; grabbing leash bare-handed = fart, release, '(It will do this every time here. Perhaps it would behave differently somewhere with gravity.)'. Fetched space suit: 'glove is a bit too big and clumsy to fit through the loop of the leash' - but 'loop' is an unknown word. Tying leash fails. I accidentally sent one command with a guessed code (refused) - my error.

**Cmds 857-890.** Left the space suit in the Pet Store. Station Control monitors now: all GREEN except PRINTING RED (was mostly red at 7006). Chapel: flipped the pulpit switch, flame out; threw the bedistor at the star twice: 'You missed.' Climbing the pulpit: 'The pulpit sways, and you fall off.' Mess Hall units: 'turns on the unit and immediately receives a tasty...meal' (sprayed acid before; not hungry, didn't try). Plan: the plastic bag in the Armory to carry the balloon creature; forgot the Armory needs the ID card - went back to the PX for it.

**Cmds 891-920.** Armory: hand limit of seven (a take fumbled the ID card); packed bedistor, form, ID into the kit; took the plastic bag (detector stays). Armory door now barely opens ('almost jamming against you'). Pet Store: 'put creature in bag' - you don't have it; 'bag over creature' - no good surface; can't wear a bag. Welders 2 and 4 approached; fled each time. Trading Post 'Ask for a timer': no one to ask. Grocery shelves bare. Idea: win a second galakmid gambling (dice at Fortune Teller) to buy item 9 and push the stuck timer out.

**Cmds 921-943.** Roll dice: 'You roll an 11 (Footnote 1)'; 'footnote 1': 'zero-gee dice which project their own gravitational field onto the nearest surface' - GRAVITY for the balloon creature! ('read footnote 1' is not understood; 'footnote 1' works.) Rolling drops the dice - went back for them. HUNGER+THIRST warning on Broadway (first since the nectar): walked to the Mess Hall, saved (slot replaced Flophouse), turned on a unit: acid again. No food. Pressing on fast.

**Cmds 944-968.** Back at the Pet Store: grabbing the leash while holding things makes me drop everything (welder 1 came; fled and returned). Rolled the dice here (7), put dice in the cage, held them - the creature still farts every time. 'Put dice on creature': no good surface. 'hold my breath' / 'nose' / 'loop' unknown words. HUNGER stage 2: 'really ravenous and your lips are quite parched.' Next idea: dice in the weightless elevator (8 refused before).

**Cmds 969-979.** Elevator from Level Five: 'The elevator shaft is supposed to be a weightless environment... But the gravity in the shaft is one standard Gee!' Typed 8: power dive, death. (My error: I fired a placeholder second call without reading - refused, nothing done.) Restored PX move 536 (coin unspent, nectar still in the Storage W of North Connection, before the hunger). Idea: kick the dispenser while WEARING the magnetic boots.

**Cmds 980-1014.** Coin in: hunger+thirst warning at once and Welder 2; type 6: klunk, stuck again. Fled W to the dark Storage, lamp on, drank the nectar ('last food'). Dropped the ID card in North Connection. Walked via Broadway, Grocery S (= Trading Post), Warehouse, Alley to the Junk Yard; junk pile has nothing else. Hand limit made me drop the detonator to take the boots; Welder 1 came; fled up to Shady Dan's and back; wore boots, retook detonator. Returning to the PX to kick the dispenser in the boots.

**Cmds 1015-1040.** PX kick wearing the magnetic boots: same 'fails to dislodge'. 'Open dispenser': can't. Floyd refuses orders; 'play hider-and-seeker with Floyd': I win, he kicks my shin. 'chewing' unknown. Theory: loaded dice win coins - Casino tables 'Totally ordinary', rolling there just repeats Footnote 1; no betting. ('gambling' unknown though it's in the room text.) I sent a second call without reading again (refused) - my discipline slip. Next: Oliver in the Robot Shop with the bedistor.

**Cmds 1041-1070.** Walked to the Robot Shop: Oliver 'won't be possible until his incubation period ends' (2-20 days). Heating chamber: small opening (Floyd fetched the bit there before; now refuses). PX: lamp on, hole 'only blackness'; dice in the hole drop out and Floyd pockets them (later drops them). Officers' Quarters C is End of Corridor S. Welders 1, 3, 4 keep approaching; stepping away always works. THEORY: the crystal ball may be the platinum - the detector went 'too hot' in the Field Office and Pet Store exactly when I was carrying the crystal ball. Next: Laundry dryer (another timer?), Theatre booth.

**Cmds 1071-1090.** Laundry: dryer open/empty, presser off/empty. Theatre booth 'Totally ordinary looking booth' / 'closed and locked'. GYM: the exercise machine is GONE ('You can't see any exercise machine here!') - it is roaming; the jammer at 710 must be the defence when it attacks. Level 7 ladder still sealed from below; Welder 4 again. Plan: zap the dispenser hole (fallback save PX 587 has the same state).

**Cmds 1091-1105.** Zapgun at the dispenser hole: 'BLAM! The dispenser is dispensed.' - the whole machine gone, no timer. Restored PX 536 (stocktake at 1100). Bought item 9 instead: also klunk and stuck - every purchase sticks. Read the nine BLUEPRINT papers for the first time (I had missed them): elevator serves Levels 1-9; Level 8 = Power Plant, Oxygen Generation, Water Purification, Arti-Grav Unit (through access hatches from a small room west of the elevator); Level 9 = Main Computer, Computer Control. Every level has a 'utility shaft' just south of the elevator. Restored PX 536 again.

**Cmds 1106-1130.** Bought the timer again (hunger warning at the coin as before). Detonator and jammer in the hole drop out (generic). Jammer ON beside the dispenser: still only fingertips. Drank the nectar in the Storage (lamp on/off). Floyd at the PX again: 'not even a ball'. 'Lift dispenser': 'as worthwhile as cleaning a grotch cage'. Filed the timer as a possible bug. 'utility' unknown at Level Five. Heading to the Dome to try the air-shaft grating.

**Cmds 1131-1142.** Dome: grating 'securely affixed'; shrubbery is junipers, rose bushes, gliffgubbers, Rhomboidal Pellet Trees. Saved in the Dome (move 567; replaced PX 536). Elevator from the Dome with the JAMMER ON, typed 8: power dive, death again. Restored Dome. Saves now: Dome 567, Mess Hall 709 (other timeline, hungry), PX 587 (other timeline).

**Cmds 1143-1163.** Commander's Quarters: safe dial 'say what number to set it to'; desk only personal items. Chapel: pulpit is an open container with the switch; Floyd refuses to hold it. Zapped the star: '(Footnote 9) ...the seven-pointed star is gone' and the game told me at once it could no longer be won (helpful!). Restored the Dome. Next: play the mauve spool (Collater Repair Manual) in the Library.

**Cmds 1164-1183.** Fetched the mauve spool from the Printing Plant ('collater' is an unknown word there). Library: Welder 3 interrupted; fled and came back. Mauve spool played: collater malfunction - 'First check the lower fromitz...' '...and replace with...' then 'You will die, human!' -> the twelve-prong fromitz board (left in the Flophouse) may repair the large collater.

## Clue log

- Form QX-17-T (package paper), handwritten: "Take a spacetruck from the Deck Five cargo bay. Proceed to Space Station Gamma Delta Gamma 777-G 59/59 Sector Alpha-Mu 79. Pick up 24 pallets of ... Form Forms. This is a Top-PRIORITY assignment!" Validation box empty. Game: "You notice that it has not been validated."
- Form QX-17-T slip "Astrogator's navigational data (time:course)": course depends on the time, e.g. 5350-5399: 259; 5400-5449: 247; 5450-5499: 235; 5500-5549: 224; 5550-5599: 213; 5600-5649: 203; 5650-5699: 193; 5700-5749: 184 ... (full table in the paper). Likely what to type into the spacetruck autopilot at launch time.
- Form HB-56-V: list of Class Three vehicles, includes FORMS TRANSPORT SPACETRUCK six/nine/twelve-meter; nothing ticked.
- Form JZ-59-G: "Applicable robot pool: Deck Five"; give to the robot pool. (Used: inserted in Robot Pool slot.)
- Chronometer back: "Good luck in the Patrol! Love, Mom and Dad."
- Station Control monitors: COMMUNICATION RED, LIFE SUPPORT GREEN, FOOD PRODUCTION RED, GRAVITY GREEN, COMPUTER GREEN, POWER GREEN, PRINTING YELLOW.
- Plato (Sick Bay): "I have not seen a soul for a day now, perhaps more." On crew: "I was going to ask you the same question!" Mentions the station's library.
- Comm Center: no one on duty though regulations demand it.
- Commander's log tape (Commander's Quarters desk; played on the log reader in Commander's Office, which then exploded at ~7628):
  - "11349.12.2.3800: ...pilfering the station's fuel cells... I have hidden the fuel cells up in the Dome's storage bin, slapped a lock on the bin, and deposited the key in my safe!" -> key in safe (safe: dial with 8000 settings, 12-20 numbers in combination).
  - "12.2.5100: ...collater #22 is off-line for routine service... unidentified craft detected in sector... Sending Finsterwald to intercept."
  - "12.2.6750: Unidentified craft towed to Docking Bay #1... remains of one of the aliens, and a featureless pyramid... used-spaceship dealer in the village named Shady Dan is selling modified Patrol ID cards. Liaison Officer Bumblewitz is investigating." -> Shady Dan's ID cards might open security doors.
  - "12.3.1900: Professor Schmidt ... extra-galactic origin."
  - "12.3.5100: ...putting the village off-limits ... No more village entry forms will be validated."
  - "12.3.5250: ...validated a whole batch of village entry forms! ... I'll hide the stamp under my bed ... Schmidt permission to move the alien pyramid to the holding tank in the Sci Sub-Module... This log reader is overheating." -> FOUND the validation stamp under the bed.
  - "12.3.7700: ...unexplainable breakdowns in the Gymnastic Equipment and the Laundering Machinery... sabotage?"
  - "12.4.1650: Emergency communication from the S.P.S. Duffy... #22 collater should be available to prepare the forms."
  - "12.4.1850: ...unexpected shutdown of web-feeder #17... spare log reader is overheating"
  - "12.4.1900: ...ensign in the filing division seriously injured when one of the hull welders malfunctioned... What the krip!..."
  Theory: the pyramid makes machines go bad. Village needs a validated village entry form.
- Commander's safe: "HyperSecurity Safe, featuring a dial with 8000 settings. There are probably between twelve and twenty numbers in the combination."
- Gym sign: "IMPORTANT! The exercise machine has diagnostic frequencies which communicate with each other on frequency 710. Do not bring anything which broadcasts on that frequency within range of the machine!"
- Lilac nanofilm spool (Docking Bay #3): "Spacetruck Refueling Instructions" (need a spool reader).
- Dream on sleeping: Floyd in charge of station, "I'm sorry, I can't do that" -- foreshadowing Floyd turning bad?
- Laundry: "a large empty spot where the washer should be."
- Lilac spool (library reader): "Replacement of depleted fuel cells on a Forms Transport Spacetruck is a fast and simple proc..." "...with the quarnum wrench against the..." "...at which point the fuel cell opening will appear..." then "You will die, human!"
- Puce spool: "Fuel must be added periodically to the flame's fuel reservoir, located..." "...ontact the station's Requisitions Officer if replacements are unavailable from the..." "...iode in the Chapel's star has an expected life of..." -> the chapel star holds a (hyper)diode; replacement for the detonator's blackened one.
- Detonator (Main Storage): "two connection points... a faint crack" - contained a blackened hyperdiode.
- Dome bin: "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies"; "A lock has been newly welded to the bin. The bin is warm to the touch."
- PA at 2553: "Deep-space communication received at Comm Center. No operator on duty."
- Comm Center screen (read at 2982): "From: Forms Control Officer, S.P.S. Duffy / To: Lieutenant First Class 1451-352-716 / Re: Current assignment / Msg: Two thousand reams of ... Form Forms found in mislabelled pallet. No additional supplies needed. Abort assignment and return to Duffy."
- Plato on the star: "Were I but several meters taller, I would happily oblige." Floyd: "Floyd shorter even than you!"
- PX Vendo-Matic: "all items: 1 galakmid" ... "6. All-Purpose Timer" and "9. Large Drill Bit" are the only items not sold out. Need a galakmid coin.
- Schmidt's diary (Engineering Office, Sci Sub-Module): ship & pyramid "well over one billion years old"; wall markings "a series of identical dots"; studied them "for nonvisual properties"; "I guess my pal, the mayor, will get to show off his linguistic training." -> the village mayor can translate the dots (maybe Braille-like/tactile or sound?). Lab machinery failed.
- Scribbled note (Bio Office), reddish-brown stains: "Schmidt -- Why didn't I see it until now! Just think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph"
- Holding Tank Level: "The thick side wall of the tank has been blasted open, and the tank is completely empty." -> pyramid escaped.
- Alien ship dots (Docking Bay #1, Level Six), copied exactly, row by row:
    .. ..
    .. .... . ... . ... ... . ...
    .. ... .
    .... . ... .
    .. ... .
  Groups by dot count: [2 2] / [2 4 1 3 1 3 3 1 3] / [2 3 1] / [4 1 3 1] / [2 3 1]. "touch the dots: no desirable effect." Pedestal empty (pyramid sat there?).
- Skeleton: "an unusually overdeveloped tongue case." -> LICK THE DOTS gives tastes (verbatim):
   "(sweet/slightly-bitter) (sweet/very-sour)
   (sweet/very-sweet) (sour/bland/bland/sour) (very-salty) (very-sweet/bland/sour) (bland) (bland/salty/sour) (bitter/sour/very-sour) (slightly-sour) (bitter/salty/bitter)
   (very-sweet/very-salty) (spicy-hot/bland/bland) (very-sweet)
   (sour/bland/sour/sweet) (bland) (very-salty/salty/sour) (very-sweet)
   (bland/bitter) (bland/sour/very-sour) (very-salty)."
  Probably a message to take to the village mayor (linguist).
- Village entry form: "Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q. It is pretty crumpled and has not been validated." Press + stamp worked.
- Travel posters: "Historic Ramos II," "Varshon, the Galactic Capital," "The Pleasure Moons of Mazzotta."
- Greasy Straw: cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar behind counter (taken).
- Trading Post sign: "!!!BEST PRICES IN TOWN!!! IF YOU DON'T SEE IT ASK FOR IT! Illegal wares shown by appointment only. FREZONE (tm) explosive available."
- FREZONE instruction sheet: "FREZONE (tm) Liquid Gorzium Explosive / Instructions for use: 1. Insert explosive in hole of appropriate diameter. 2. Attach detonator to explosive and timer. 3. Set timer. 4. Vamoose. NOTE: Do not expose explosive to temperatures above 150 degrees Kelvin for periods of more than 100 millichrons." -> safe: drill hole (bit sizes small/medium/large), explosive, detonator (needs working hyperdiode from chapel star), timer (Vendo-Matic #6, 1 galakmid). - DONE late in the leg: the detonator now holds a J-series hyperdiode (from the Studio sculpture), so the Chapel star is no longer needed for it.
- Shady Dan's innocuous machine (keypad + very small slot, now ON): probably the ID-card modifier from the Commander's log -> try the ID card in the slot, then the keypad.
- Theatre booth lock; Gym machine sign (frequency 710); Level 8 sealed; the pyramid is loose and machines are turning hostile. Duffy says abort and go home (but the truck needs fuel?).
- Twelve-prong fromitz board left in the Trading Post; I carry a twenty-prong one and a twenty-ohm bedistor (spare parts for something).

### Numbers and procedures from the papers
- Patrol ID 1451-352-716 (all forms).
- Course table on Form QX-17-T: find the row for the current time and type that course on the truck keypad. I typed 313 at time 5167 (row 5150-5199) and it worked. (328 at 5146 launched too, but I died because the hatch was open.)
- Form JZ-59-G: put it in the Robot Pool slot, then type the bin number (3 = Floyd).
- Form HB-56-V: put it in the truck slot once both seats are filled.

### What I would try next
0. At Shady Dan's: try the ID card in the machine's very small slot and see what the keypad asks. If it raises my rank, try the Sick Bay / End of Corridor security doors.
1. Switch on the headlamp and explore Storage (N of the Workshop), the File Room and the Shipping Room.
2. Finish the village: the Main Street exits (S, SE, up, down) and the other Trading Post exits; look for Shady Dan, the mayor, a galakmid (go back to the Barbershop with the detector, carefully, since it warms up).
3. Ask at the Trading Post about FREZONE; get the PX timer and large bit with a coin; then the safe.
4. Work out how to grab the balloon creature (or reach the star some other way) for the hyperdiode.

## Leg handoff (leg 2, claude-opus-5-5, 400 commands, score 54/80 (best 57, lost to a dud blast after a restore), Novem 6 = day 3, chronometer stopped; in the Commander's Quarters; latest saves: slot 15 = Quarters, hole drilled, detonator closed and on the floor wired to the timer (CURRENT STATE is just after it); slot 17 = Quarters, hole drilled, detonator still open and carried; slot 16 = Flophouse)

### Map so far (additions this leg; see the leg 1 handoff for the rest)
- Village: Shady Dan's (ID machine) -> down Junk Yard (magnetic boots, now in the Warehouse) -> W Alley hub: N Missionary, S Loan Shark (strong box, zapped), NE Warehouse (airlock down -> "In Space" vac yard), SE "Doc" Schuster's (letter), SW Pawn Shop, NW/up Main Street. Main Street UP = Mayor's Office (glossary). Casino: turning the roulette wheel opens N Opium Den and UP Flophouse (locker: space suit; suit and foil left there).
- Station: Sick Bay E security door -> Brig (empty). End of Corridor N security door -> Armory (jammer left there). Mess Hall E = the ELEVATOR: deadly, never use it. Level Eight still sealed from below.

### Puzzles solved this leg
- Shady Dan's machine: card in slot, keypad 10 -> rank 10 Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral; opens the Sick Bay and End of Corridor security doors (+5 at the Armory).
- Mayor's glossary -> the alien message says the pyramid's one weakness is element 78 = platinum.
- Ostrich nip in the Pet Store ceiling panel (+3). Platinum foil behind the Barbershop mirror (break it) (+4).
- Plato's ambush after the jammer goes off; Floyd saves you (+7).
- Zapgun: strong box -> galakmid (+5); welders vanish. Coin in the PX slot, type 6 -> timer stuck; nip in the dispenser hole -> ostrich frees the timer (+6).
- Roulette wheel -> Flophouse space suit (+4). Suit + magnetic boots (leave the ID card behind!) + Thermos closed -> airlock -> In Space (+3) -> FREZONE explosive; carry it in the closed Thermos.
- Safe: medium bit hole; explosive in the hole (+3; this one was undone by my restore).

### Open puzzles and theories
- THE SAFE (next step): open the Thermos, put the explosive in the hole, connect the detonator (closed, on the floor, already wired to the timer) to the explosive, set the timer to about 30-40 (a walk is about 22), go W and wait. If it still fizzles, the J-series hyperdiode may be the wrong kind (the Chapel star's hyperdiode is the canon spare?). The safe holds the Dome bin key -> fuel cells.
- Fuel cells -> refuel the truck (needs a quarnum wrench, not found) -> fly. But the chronometer has STOPPED and the course table needs the time. Look for another clock.
- The pyramid: building a replica factory (Level Eight, sealed from below?). Weapon: the platinum foil (in the Flophouse).
- Floyd is turning hostile (shoves, stomps, nightmares about him). Watch him.
- Balloon creature (needs gravity; spores in Storage N of Workshop); Chapel star; Oliver the unborn robot; Theatre booth.

### Numbers and procedures from the papers
- Patrol ID 1451-352-716. Truck course: QX-17-T row for the current time (time unknown now). Robot form JZ-59-G: slot, bin 3 = Floyd.
- FREZONE sheet (Trading Post): hole of appropriate diameter (medium bit = pencil) -> attach detonator to explosive and timer -> set timer -> vamoose; keep below 150 K for no more than 100 millichrons (so carry it in the closed Thermos and move fast). The timer counts millichrons: an action is about 7, a walk about 22.

### What I would try next
1. From the current state: Thermos open, explosive in the hole, connect the detonator to the explosive, set the timer to 30, go W to the Office, wait. Then take the key from the safe.
2. Key -> Dome storage bin -> fuel cells. Look for the quarnum wrench and a working clock.
3. Fetch the foil (Flophouse) for the pyramid; find a way down to Level Eight.
4. Food: the Greasy Straw counter (search it) refills with fire nectar.

## Leg handoff (leg 3, claude-opus-5-5, ~365 of 400 commands, score 80/80, WON on day 4 (Novem 7); latest saves: slot 16 = Factory (score 75, Floyd armed, foil carried), slot 17 = Bottom of Air Shaft, slot 15 = Commander's Quarters after the blast)

The game is won (80 of 80, "Intergalactic Mega-Hero"). I stopped with about 35 commands of the leg left because there is nothing left to play; nothing remains open.

### Map so far (additions this leg)
- Trading Post DOWN = Warehouse (the short way to the airlock). Makeshift Connector: the space suit will not fit through the iris hatch.
- Dome -> (after the bin blows) air shaft grating -> Top of Air Shaft -> Air Shaft (several levels) -> Bottom of Air Shaft -> floor grating -> Computer Control (Level Nine?: ladder up to Level Eight, elevator N) -> up = Factory (Level Eight).

### Puzzles solved this leg
- Chapel star: spray spores room by room to lead the balloon creature from the Pet Store into gravity and on to the Chapel; switch the flame off at the pulpit first (it fears the flame); take the leash in gravity and it lifts you; open the star, take the M-series hyperdiode (+7). The J-series one from the Studio is a dud that burns out.
- FREZONE: the explosive softens even in the closed Thermos, but stops in the vac yard, so you can park it there. Set everything up first (hole drilled with the medium bit; detonator with the M diode, closed, on the floor, wired to the timer), then fetch the explosive and go straight back (Warehouse - Trading Post - Grocery - Broadway - Connector (suit OFF) - East Connection - Station Control - Office - Quarters). - Dome: key unlocks the bin; opening it blows up the fuel cells and loosens the air shaft grating; enter (+2).
- Bring the JAMMER (Armory) before the lights fail. Computer Control: jammer on (freezes the exercise machine), the forklift arrives, jammer off (they destroy each other). Up (+2).
- Factory: zap Floyd, put the reflective foil on the pyramid (+5). Win.

### Open puzzles and theories
- None; the game is won. Never used: the fuel cells/truck refuelling, the quarnum wrench, the collater repair (twelve-prong board), the course table after the chronometer stopped. These seem to be red herrings or alternate content.

### Numbers and procedures from the papers
- Patrol ID 1451-352-716. QX-17-T course table: course for the current time (313 at 5167 worked). Robot form JZ-59-G: slot, bin 3 = Floyd.
- FREZONE instruction sheet: hole of the right diameter (medium bit = pencil), attach the detonator to the explosive and the timer, set the timer, vamoose; keep it below 150 K (so park it in the vac yard and carry it in the Thermos for the final dash). - Gym sign: frequency 710 for the jammer (used again in Computer Control).

### What I would try next
- Nothing needed. A tester replaying could check whether the truck/fuel-cell branch leads anywhere, and could time the lights failing and the headlamp battery.

friction.command: wait (after setting course with hatch open)
friction.result: Truck launches, air gushes out the open hatch, you die
friction.why: Fair, canon death; the 'can't reach the hatch from the pilot seat' line was a hint, and a save made it cheap. Still a harsh first lesson.

friction.result: You're neither hungry nor thirsty. (You'll be able to eat once you are hungry, in about 287 moves.)
friction.why: The countdown hint is great for a short-burst player planning food; also the orange goo covered thirst too

friction.result: At the moment, the screen is displaying a message.
friction.why: Examine did not show the message; I had to open the screen menu and pick Read. On a tablet I'd expect Examine to show it, or the reply to hint 'read it'

friction.command: put crumpled form in presser / turn on / turn off / open
friction.result: neatly ironed Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q
friction.why: Satisfying chain: slot says 'crumpledness prevents it', I remembered the laundry presser, and the steam warnings let a cautious player switch it off in time

friction.command: 870 take (leash, Pet Store) and 'Floyd, take leash'
friction.result: creature farts in your face, you drop everything; Floyd: 'Enough talking! Let's play Hider-and-Seeker.'
friction.why: Funny, but I can't see how to get the leash: no 'hold nose' in menus, and Floyd refuses with an unrelated line that doesn't tell me if robots could do it

friction.result: ID card twitches toward the magnetic soles: carried together it would be wiped (no second warning)
friction.why: Fair warning before an unrecoverable loss; perfect for a cautious player

friction.result: Printed the Studio heading text ('cluttered space bubble... pile of random garbage') and then '## Junk Yard' with its own description
friction.why: Two room descriptions for one move; unclear whether I am in the Studio or the Junk Yard (the Studio was W of the Trading Post)

friction.command: turn off jammer (Gym) -> Plato stuns me; Floyd, turn off Plato / take ray / save me / help
friction.result: Plato's villain speech over 4 turns; Floyd always 'in quandry', then knocks the gun away on his own and Plato is blown apart (+7)
friction.why: Dramatic and moving; the Tell-Floyd menu offered pointed choices (Turn off Plato, Save you) that all got the same reply, so I could not tell whether anything I said mattered

friction.command: put nip in hole (PX dispenser, timer stuck after 'klunk')
friction.result: ostrich sticks its head up the hole after the nip, the timer falls out, ostrich gets drunk on the nip (+6)
friction.why: Lovely payoff: letter -> ceiling panel -> ostrich following -> stuck dispenser all clicked together, and the Put it in... menu offered the hole

friction.result: elevator power-dives; you have died
friction.why: The only warning was the odd gravity line on entering; fair in Infocom style, and I had saved, but a click player sees an innocent keypad entry with no hint of danger

friction.command: Trading Post: looking for a way to 'ask for' FREZONE (sign: IF YOU DON'T SEE IT ASK FOR IT! ... FREZONE (tm) explosive available)
friction.result: no Ask/Ask for entry on the sign, the village, the room or any item menu; no shopkeeper present
friction.why: The sign invites a typed 'ask for frezone'; click mode offers no way to try it, so I cannot tell if it is a red herring or a missing verb

friction.command: connect detonator to explosive (in safe hole), set timer to 5, west
friction.result: 'You'll have to disconnect the explosive first.' Timer hits 0: 'sizzling sound from the detonator, and a burnt odor'; the J-series hyperdiode vanished, no explosion
friction.why: I could not tell why it fizzled: hyperdiode wrong type, explosive already softened, or because I held the detonator? The timer's own note (5 = one walk) was very helpful, but the reason for the dud was not

friction.command: set timer to 15, west, wait (detonator closed, on the floor, wired to timer and explosive)
friction.result: No sound or message; then '(The game can no longer be won: the explosive has melted away...)'. Back in the room the detonator's J-series hyperdiode is gone again
friction.why: Second dud with no explanation of why. From the next room I hear nothing, so I only learn the diode burned by opening the detonator. A hint that the J-series diode is the wrong kind would have saved two restores. The unwinnable notice itself was very helpful

friction.command: spray can room by room from Broadway to the Chapel, turn off flame switch, take leash, open star, take M-series hyperdiode
friction.result: creature follows each spore puff, lifts me in gravity; it shies from the lit flame; star holds an M-series hyperdiode (+7)
friction.why: Lovely chain: each step gave a visible reaction (it follows the spores, sinks at the gravity line, flees the flame), so I could reason my way through

friction.command: west (from Makeshift Connector, wearing the space suit, explosive softening in the Thermos)
friction.result: The space suit is too bulky to fit through the partially dilated iris hatch.
friction.why: Fair rule, but it cost two turns while the explosive was on a clock; the compass showing W as '(special)' hinted at it, which I noticed only afterwards

friction.command: down (in the Air Shaft below the Dome, Novem 7)
friction.result: 'The light from the headlamp flickers and dies!' then '(The game can no longer be won: the headlamp is dead, with the jammer left in the dark.)'
friction.why: The unwinnable notice is very helpful and tells me what to fix (fetch the jammer before the lights fail). But nothing earlier told me the jammer would be needed again after the Gym, or that the headlamp had a limited life beyond 'seems somewhat dimmer'

friction.command: turn on jammer (exercise machine freezes), turn off jammer (it crushes the forklift), up, shoot Floyd, put foil on pyramid
friction.result: Machines destroy each other; Factory; pyramid explodes; Floyd's farewell; Oliver asks to play; You have won, 80/80
friction.why: A tense, readable finale: every step gave clear feedback, the launch countdown and reactor lights made the time pressure clear, and the menus offered exactly the actions I needed. Shooting Floyd was hard for my persona, but the game earns it
